title: (New) Apple Mac Pro Wheels Kit

comparisons.notes: Brand new sealed, MPN MX572ZM/A, UPC 190199319486, same item, in stock (only 2 units left).

writeup: Apple's official Mac Pro Wheels Kit (MX572ZM/A) swaps the 2019 Mac Pro's feet for stainless steel and rubber wheels so the tower rolls around your desk. Apple discontinued the kit in March 2026, and RetailKing still lists a new sealed one at $630.12. Woot has it new for $129.99, but only 2 were left when we checked.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN matches MPN MX572ZM/A and UPC 190199319486 per verified check.
